title: SubjectRef
description: The only permitted way to reference a natural person on the bus. `pid` is a gateway-issued pairwise pseudonym as defined in SPEC section 6; it is never a raw identifier and is never constructible outside `identity-gateway`. Only `transit` and `identity` may carry subject references: `traffic` and `telemetry` are anonymous domains and `vision` uses `track_ref` instead, so the domain token is restricted accordingly and a `sub:vision:` pseudonym fails validation here as well as in `beb-lint`.

pid.description: Pairwise pseudonym: "sub:" domain ":e" epoch ":" base32(HMAC-SHA256(K_domain_epoch, root_subject_id)[0..10]).

epoch.description: Pseudonym epoch. MUST equal the epoch encoded in `pid`; JSON Schema cannot express the cross-field equality, so `beb-lint` and both SDKs enforce it.
